fieldValues.title: A domain workspace: understand one domain whole, affirm there, then move sideways or up
fieldValues.move: One view per domain that shows its personas-in-domain, problems and remedies, axes with local pole names, archetypal lean, and the conversations that generated it, with the parent's personas and axes offered to a subdomain by default and the subdomains' influences visible from the parent, one level down. Affirmation and prioritisation happen in that view; the objective/epic roadmap is fed from the domains' priorities. Start as a read-only view in srs-lab control room over the existing records before any new type.
fieldValues.does_not_fix: The cost of affirming one record at a time (d00f101f) and the orthogonality test for poles (4a085b1a); those remedies sit inside this frame.
fieldValues.falsifier: The owner still clicks accept inside the domain view, or domains do not partition the problems cleanly enough to prioritise within one.
fieldValues.return_when: Affirmation in a domain is still slower than writing the record.
